name: Black★Hypno Shooter
source:
This game is about a strange creature that came after Mato from a different dimension and is after her because of her special powers. To make her it's property, it uses mind control.

[edited from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209174147/http://ffecchifan.deviantart.com/art/Black-Hypno-Shooter-212366510]official site[/url]]

The events happen after the end of the "Black Rock Shooter" anime.
translation:
一只来自异次元的神秘生物追踪黑衣麻陶而来，因为她拥有特殊力量。为了把麻陶变成自己的所有物，它对她施加精神控制。

[根据 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161209174147/http://ffecchifan.deviantart.com/art/Black-Hypno-Shooter-212366510]官方网站[/url]编辑]

故事发生在动画《黑岩射手》结局之后。
